### Feature Summary

A clear and concise description of what the new feature is and what problem it solves.

_e.g. This feature allows users to save the serial port log to a file._

### Proposed Functionality

Describe the new functionality from the user's perspective.

_e.g. A "Save Log" button will be added to the toolbar. When clicked, a file save dialog will appear, allowing the user to specify a file name and location. The log will be saved in plain text format._

### Additional Context

Add any other context, mockups, or links to related issues here.

_e.g. Related to issue #12._
